lines.zh: 我拖着方方正正的身子走
lines.en: I drag my box-shaped body along.
Four short fins cannot bear the weight.

lines.zh: 我走一步，箱角就在土里划
lines.en: Each step, a corner scores the soil.

lines.zh: 森林里的落叶堆到我的背上
lines.en: Fallen leaves pile on my back.

lines.zh: 我像一只被人丢下的箱子
lines.en: I look like a chest someone abandoned.

lines.zh: 苔藓已经长到我的接缝里
lines.en: Moss has grown into my seams.
I crash through a clump of low brush.
My lid clatters the whole way.
I cross the flowers and they all bend.
I stop to breathe and my body heaves.
My shadow is square.
I walk around a birch.
I crush a dead twig underfoot.
My fins dig into wet mud.
I nose a stone out of the way.

lines.zh: 我爬过一道倒下的树干
lines.en: I climb over a fallen trunk.
I lie still in the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 苔藓、泥土、花瓣盖在我身上
lines.en: Moss, soil, petals cover me.
I look exactly like a chest.
I wait for someone to open me.

lines.zh: 我的盖子合得密密实实
lines.en: My lid shuts tight.
The forest wind goes around me.
One fin twitches.
A bird lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我没有真的锁，可我不开
lines.en: There is no real lock, but I do not open.

lines.zh: 一朵蘑菇从我边上冒出来
lines.en: A mushroom sprouts beside me.

lines.zh: 晒太阳的时候苔藓更绿了
lines.en: Sun makes the moss greener.

lines.zh: 我把盖子抬了一点透气
lines.en: I lift my lid slightly for air.
A deer looks at me and moves on.
My fins spread in the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，露出正面
lines.en: I turn slowly to show my front.
You are staring at my lid.
You are wondering what is inside.

lines.zh: 我没有宝藏，只有骨头和海水
lines.en: I hold no treasure, only bone and seawater.

lines.zh: 你伸手的话，我会先动手
lines.en: Reach out and I will strike first.
My lid lifts an inch.
You stepped back; wise.
The moss slides off me.

lines.zh: 你把脚从我的影子边挪开
lines.en: You move your foot from my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的方形影子正好罩住你的鞋
lines.en: My square shadow covers your shoe.
One of my corners is chopped open.
Seawater leaks from the seam.
My whole body tilts.
My lid will not close flush.
I shake the moss off.
I shrink down into the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的盖子松开了一道缝
lines.en: My lid loosens at one seam.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只短鳍走不快
lines.en: I drag one short fin and cannot move fast.

lines.zh: 我把自己往泥里压了压
lines.en: I press myself deeper into the mud.
All four fins slip at once.

lines.zh: 你把东西举到我的盖子前
lines.en: You hold it before my lid.

lines.zh: 我的鳍抓不住这么小的东西
lines.en: My fins cannot grasp anything that small.

lines.zh: 那味道从缝里钻进来了
lines.en: That smell seeps in through my seams.
I open my lid a crack.

lines.zh: 你在逗我，可我还是想吃
lines.en: You are teasing me, but I still want it.
I open my lid a little wider.

lines.zh: 我吞了一口海水，压了压饿
lines.en: I swallow seawater to ease the hunger.

lines.zh: 你把东西晃来晃去，我跟着转
lines.en: You swing it about and I turn with it.
All four of my fins brace.

lines.zh: 里面伸出一截舌头又收回
lines.en: A tongue reaches out and pulls back in.
You hit my square corner, and it is hard.
My body rocks.
You step on my lid and slip.
I lean my weight into you.
Leaves fly up around us.

lines.zh: 我的接缝夹到你的手指
lines.en: My seam pinches your finger.

lines.zh: 你把膝盖撞在我的斜角上
lines.en: Your knee meets my slanted corner.

lines.zh: 我们撞出的声响像敲木箱
lines.en: We knock like a struck crate.

lines.zh: 我往前顶了一步，你退了两步
lines.en: I push one step; you give two.

lines.zh: 叶片被我们踢得满天飞
lines.en: We kick the leaves up everywhere.
Two chests lie side by side.
Our moss mingles.

lines.zh: 森林里没有人来开我们
lines.en: No one comes to open us in this forest.

lines.zh: 她的盖子碰着我的盖子
lines.en: Her lid taps mine.
Together we pretend to be stones.

lines.zh: 她的盖子歪了，我帮她推正
lines.en: Her lid is crooked; I nudge it straight.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背，苔藓挨着苔藓
lines.en: We sit back to back, moss to moss.

lines.zh: 我们的影子并成一个方块
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one block.
She says I cannot hide; I am too square.

lines.zh: 我们一起等着，谁都不动
lines.en: We both wait, neither moving.

lines.zh: 我的鳍笨，只能把东西压住
lines.en: My fins are clumsy; I can only pin it.
I clamp it with my lid.

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西，我收进缝里
lines.en: I tuck what fell into my seams.

lines.zh: 我把它吞进去，卡在边角
lines.en: I swallow it, and it lodges in a corner.
I push it along ahead of me.
My fins cradle it with effort.

lines.zh: 地上的一朵蘑菇被我压扁
lines.en: I flatten a mushroom on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把东西收进盖子下面
lines.en: I tuck it under my lid.
I roll it along for half a turn.
I grip it with my corner.
My lid opens all the way.
What is inside is not gold, but teeth.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我这箱子就开。
lines.en: One step closer and this chest opens.
I arrange myself like a chest again.

lines.zh: 我的盖子里面亮着一线
lines.en: A seam of light shows inside my lid.

lines.zh: 我把苔藓都抖掉，露出本色
lines.en: I shake off the moss to show my true shell.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，贴住地面
lines.en: I press my body low to the ground.
I wait for your hand.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝的声音，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count each twig you snap.
I heave my lid open a finger's width.
I stay put and wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 你伸手的那一刻，我就咬
lines.en: The moment you reach, I bite.
My fins scrape the ground.
I watch your hands, not your face.
You walk one circle around me.
You crouch down in front of me.
I see the ring on your hand.

lines.zh: 我这方方正正的身子，正卡在树根间。
lines.en: This boxy body of mine is wedged between roots.
My seams slowly open.
Your reaching hand halts in the air.
My lid snaps shut.
I ram your foot with a corner.
A row of something reaches out.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的盖子还在响
lines.en: You retreat; my lid still chatters.
My lid clamps on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我这口箱子，撞上去很沉。
lines.en: This chest body of mine slams down heavy.

lines.zh: 里面那排牙齿咬了两下
lines.en: That row of teeth inside snaps twice.

lines.zh: 我拖着你往后退了一步
lines.en: I drag you back a step.
I let go and leaves burst into your face.

lines.zh: 我的箱身顶得你跪了一下
lines.en: My body knocks you to one knee.
I push the fallen leaves up from beneath.
I shift out between tree roots.
Moss still clings to me.

lines.zh: 森林里多了一只不像箱子的箱子
lines.en: The forest gains a chest that is not a chest.

lines.zh: 我把盖子抬了一下，又合上
lines.en: I lift my lid once, then close it.
My four fins brace in the mud.

lines.zh: 我把一片叶子顶到头上
lines.en: I lift a leaf onto my head.

lines.zh: 我从花丛里挪出来，花全折了
lines.en: I shift out of the flowers; all bent.

lines.zh: 我停下，像谁丢下的一只箱
lines.en: I stop, like a chest someone left.

lines.zh: 苔藓上还挂着一只小虫
lines.en: A small bug still clings to my moss.

lines.zh: 火把我的木纹外壳烤得裂开
lines.en: Fire cracks my wooden-looking shell.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，盖子摔开
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my lid falls open.

lines.zh: 我本是海里的东西，可这水太淡
lines.en: I come from the sea, yet this water is too fresh.
The blast flips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的盖子上
lines.en: An arrow pins into my lid.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进缝里，里面全乱了
lines.en: Magic enters my seams and everything inside churns.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃到东西，盖子发软
lines.en: I have not eaten in long, and my lid goes soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在盖子上，我整只箱子发麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes my lid and my whole chest goes numb.

lines.zh: 落叶没有了，我一直往下落
lines.en: No leaves left; I keep falling.
